phase_name: Release validation and next-generation native UI prototype

completed_tasks.name: Freeze Phase 10.1 guitar corpus acceptance
completed_tasks.progress: Development 107/108 and sealed holdout 30/30 under the frozen 40 ms profile; deterministic cleanup, blind QA, and corpus provenance complete.

completed_tasks.name: Validate faster development-only attack candidate
completed_tasks.progress: The uncommitted 10 ms attack candidate passed the full 108-file development gate: 108/108 exact, zero retriggers, clean deterministic releases, p50 16.0 ms and p95 26.7 ms. The sealed holdout was not rerun.

completed_tasks.name: Make guitar routing and UI truthful, then verify real hardware
completed_tasks.progress: Implemented start-boundary device/config sync, 1-based channel display, restart on live device/channel changes, stale-state reset, schema-v3 DSP defaults, fixed 21 ms analysis presentation, separate PITCH and MIDI OUT status, legible platform typography, simplified guitar controls, and debug NoteOn/NoteOff logs. Optimized Tauri started on Audient iD14 channel 2 and reported no build failure, but no played-note log sequence was captured before pause, so sustain/latency hardware acceptance remains open.

remaining_tasks.name: Finish optimized real-guitar and focused-diff validation
remaining_tasks.details: Test short notes, 3-5 second sustains, repeated plucks, bends and slides in optimized Tauri; inspect [guitar-midi], [guitar_bridge], and CC123 logs; then independently review and commit only the focused guitar/UI slice.

remaining_tasks.name: Build a separate functional native prototype covering the entire app
remaining_tasks.details: Do not replace or restyle the current production UI. Build a separate native, functioning prototype for all Contrapunk features. Preserve the approved density and monochrome direction; use color only when it represents live or generated sound. Retain the piano roll and add a continuous guitar expression dot/trail that can be compared with emitted MIDI.

remaining_tasks.name: Complete release-surface acceptance and v1.3.0 packaging
remaining_tasks.details: Standalone/browser/Logic/REAPER, sample-rate, block-size, device-loss, routing documentation, installers, signing, notarization and release validation remain.

decisions.decision: Build the new UI as a separate functional native prototype, not as changes to the current product UI.
decisions.rationale: The user wants freedom to redesign every app feature without destabilizing the current release candidate.

decisions.decision: The prototype uses monochrome structure and typography; color appears only when it encodes live or generated sound.
decisions.rationale: The user approved the density and monochrome direction and rejected unnecessary decorative color or information.

decisions.decision: The full-app prototype retains the piano roll and adds a continuous Guitar expression trace alongside discrete emitted MIDI.
decisions.rationale: Pitch position can show bends/slides/vibrato, amplitude can affect point size/brightness, and detector clarity can affect opacity while MIDI remains auditable.

decisions.decision: Use optimized Rust for guitar performance testing.
decisions.rationale: Debug DSP overflowed the bounded worker queue and produced misleading forced cleanup and CC123 behavior.

decisions.decision: Keep the analysis window fixed at 1,024 samples (about 21 ms at 48 kHz) and treat 10 ms as the current attack-confirmation candidate.
decisions.rationale: A 5 ms window lacks enough waveform periods for reliable low-guitar fundamentals; the 10 ms confirmation candidate passed development at p95 26.7 ms.

decisions.decision: Keep the sealed holdout untouched until final freeze.
decisions.rationale: Development and hardware evidence must drive tuning without leaking holdout feedback.

next_action: Resume by treating the new UI as a separate full-app native prototype. First inventory every production feature/capability and agree on the prototype's top-level navigation and isolation boundary; do not edit or replace the current production UI. Then implement the smallest native shell that reuses existing backend/adapter behavior. Preserve monochrome idle structure, show color only for sound, retain the piano roll, and include the continuous guitar-expression-versus-MIDI visualization. Keep the 10 ms guitar candidate and focused UI/runtime diff uncommitted until optimized hardware verification and focused review are complete.
context_notes: The user likes the clean native-system typography, information density, and monochrome direction of the HTML concept. They explicitly want a real functioning native prototype for all Contrapunk features, developed separately from the current UI. The temporary concept is useful as a visual seed but is guitar-only and not implementation architecture. The optimized Tauri test process was stopped for pause. Elixir/Golem remain excluded from the v1.3.0 release and from this prototype unless explicitly re-scoped. User performs GUI/manual testing; launch apps only on explicit request.
